title: Mechanistic feasibility
empirical_anchor: Same-lineage recurrence and paralog substitution are both demonstrable at short timescales
claim_boundary: Feasible does not mean recurrent as one complete pathway package

title: Observation regime
empirical_anchor: Published A/F/C/P coverage is nonuniform; candidate-free remeasurement uses one frozen pathway-wide protocol
claim_boundary: Observation process is measured separately from biology

title: Identified recurrence
empirical_anchor: Whole-package recurrence is removed from the admissible set; modular reuse remains class-dependent
claim_boundary: A/F/C/P are transcript-state modules, not exact genes or metabolites

title: Macroevolutionary realization
empirical_anchor: Nearest-same-colour local clustering survives topology and wild-colour coding
claim_boundary: Unrooted pattern only; not a transition-rate or causal estimate

title: Event-identifiability boundary
empirical_anchor: Strict x dominant accepted robust transitions = 0
claim_boundary: Branch-specific ecological and molecular causation stops here

title: Persistence / filtering context
empirical_anchor: Ecology is retained at reproductive-service and persistence level
claim_boundary: No individual colour-transition branch cause is assigned
